coverage.core: Official common Prelims and Mains clauses, organised into an editorial subject/topic/subtopic tree. Labels are concise paraphrases, not a verbatim reproduction.
coverage.optionals: All official optional subject choices are indexed under their papers; specialised optional topic/subtopic expansion is intentionally not claimed.
coverage.bpsc_scheme: Current paper names follow the 72nd CCE advertisement, not the superseded marks scheme in the older syllabus PDF.
